name: 구영

tips.주어-동사: many, several, one of, other 뒤에는 복수명사! many parks, one of my favourite books, other people.
tips.동사·시제: 습관은 현재시제, 과거 질문은 과거로 끝까지(wanted, spoke). 동사를 빼먹지 않기.
tips.문장 구조: look + 형용사(looks adorable), look like + 명사. like to watch / like watching 섞지 않기. 남을 먼저: My father and I.
tips.관사·전치사: listen to, travel to. 처음 말하는 건 a(a Korean restaurant), the는 남발하지 않기. go home(to 없음), at home.
tips.단어 선택: technology·rubbish는 셀 수 없는 명사. 식물은 grow, 사람은 grow up. fun(즐거운) vs funny(웃긴). teach-taught, think-thought.

focus.1: 가장 쉬운 아이디어로, 문법 실수 없이! Part 3는 직설적인 답 + 근거 + 예시.
focus.4: 막히면 다른 구조로 바꿔 말하기. Part 2 서론은 짧게, 본론은 길게.
focus.5: usually 대신 more often than not, every now and then으로 바꿔 말하기!
focus.11: other + 복수명사(other people). lie(눕다)와 lay(눕히다) 구분하기.

compare: look + 형용사: He looks adorable · look like + 명사: He looks like his dad
grow plants 식물을 키우다 · kids grow up 아이들이 자라다
time-saving 시간을 아껴 주는 · time-consuming 시간이 많이 드는

cards.en: There are many parks in my city.
cards.gram: many 뒤에는 복수명사: many parks.

cards.en: There are many universities in my city.
cards.gram: university → universities(y를 i로 바꾸고 -es).

cards.en: I listen to music when I relax.
cards.gram: listen to + 대상. to를 빼먹지 않기!

cards.en: I've travelled to several countries.
cards.gram: several 뒤에도 복수명사: several countries.

cards.ko: 질문을 다르게 말씀해 주실 수 있나요?
cards.en: Could you rephrase the question?
cards.gram: 질문을 못 알아들었을 때: Could you rephrase the question? / Could you repeat the question? 통째로 암기!

cards.en: I feel refreshed after a walk.
cards.gram: feel refreshed = 상쾌하다. 기분은 -ed: I'm interested, I feel stressed.

cards.en: I like watching movies.
cards.gram: like + -ing 또는 like to + 동사원형. to watching ❌ 둘을 섞지 않기!

cards.en: I usually wear sweatshirts and sweatpants.
cards.gram: '트레이닝복'은 콩글리시. sweatshirt(상의), sweatpants(하의), tracksuit(세트).

cards.en: It's a dish which is called bibimbap.
cards.gram: 영어 이름이 없을 때: which is called ~. 이름이 기억 안 나면 What's it called?

cards.en: I'm not a picky eater.
cards.gram: picky eater = 편식하는 사람. Food 질문에 바로 쓰세요.

cards.en: It's ten to eight.
We were in the same batch.
cards.gram: batch = 동기, 기수. She is my batchmate.

cards.ko: 그 브랜드는 꽤 오랫동안 있어 왔어요.
cards.en: That brand has been around for a while.
cards.gram: have been around for a while = 꽤 오래 있어 왔다.

cards.en: We finally closed a deal.
cards.gram: close a deal = 계약을 체결하다. Part 2 사업가 묘사에 좋아요.

cards.en: He looks adorable.
cards.gram: look + 형용사: looks adorable. look like 뒤에는 명사: He looks like his dad.

cards.en: I'm a morning person.
cards.gram: morning person ↔ night owl(밤형 인간). 주제에 딱 붙는 표현으로 점수 올리기.

cards.en: I sleep in on weekends.
cards.gram: sleep in = 늦잠 자다(일부러 늦게까지 자다).

cards.en: I enjoy listening to music.
cards.gram: enjoy + -ing. enjoy to listen ❌

cards.en: I've eaten worse.
cards.gram: I've eaten worse. = 그 정도면 괜찮아요(더 별로인 것도 먹어 봤다). 가볍게 넘길 때.

cards.en: Price-wise, it's quite cheap.
cards.gram: 명사 + -wise = ~ 면에서: price-wise, location-wise.

cards.en: I can't be bothered to cook today.
cards.gram: I can't be bothered to + 동사 = ~하기 귀찮다.

cards.en: Doctors are respected by others.
cards.gram: 수동태 be respected by ~ = ~에게 존경받다. Perfect job 답변에 활용.

cards.en: I usually go jogging in the evening.
cards.gram: 습관, 반복되는 일은 현재시제: I usually go.

cards.ko: 아버지는 제게 예의 바르게 행동하는 법을 가르쳐 주셨어요.
cards.en: My father taught me how to be polite.
cards.gram: teach의 과거는 taught(thought는 think의 과거). 막히면 다른 구조로: taught me how to be polite.
cards.mine: My father thought me about politeness.

cards.en: I try to stay in shape.
cards.gram: stay in shape = 몸매·건강을 유지하다. get in shape = 몸을 만들다.

cards.en: As far as I remember, it was my first match.
cards.gram: As far as I remember, = 내가 기억하기로는. 과거 이야기 시작할 때 좋아요.

cards.en: I took up yoga last year.
cards.gram: take up = (취미로) 시작하다. 과거 took up.

cards.en: I was on a diet, but I fell off the wagon.
cards.gram: fall off the wagon = 끊었던 나쁜 습관으로 돌아가다.

cards.en: Jazz is growing on me.
cards.gram: ~ is growing on me = 점점 좋아지다, 관심이 생기다.

cards.ko: 요리할 때 물 만난 물고기 같아요.
cards.en: I feel I'm in my element when I cook.
cards.gram: be in one's element = 물 만난 물고기 같다, 제일 편하고 잘 맞다.

cards.en: I need to brush up on my English.
cards.gram: brush up on ~ = (잊은 실력을) 다시 다듬다.

cards.ko: 그 선수는 대회에 참가해서 상금을 받았어요.
cards.en: He participated in the tournament and won the prize money.
cards.gram: participate in = ~에 참가하다. prize money = 상금.

cards.en: It's the fastest way.
cards.gram: 짧은 형용사는 -est: fast → the fastest. most는 긴 형용사에만(the most expensive).

cards.en: I ate at a Korean restaurant yesterday.
cards.gram: 처음 말하는 식당은 a, 그리고 어떤 식당인지 구체적으로: a Korean restaurant.

cards.en: I have a soft spot for dogs.
cards.gram: have a soft spot for + 명사 = ~에 약하다, 유난히 좋아하다.

cards.en: I try to keep up with the trends.
cards.gram: keep up with ~ = ~에 뒤처지지 않다. Technology 질문에 좋아요.

cards.en: Technology has changed our lives a lot.
cards.gram: technology는 셀 수 없는 명사. technologies ❌, has changed.

cards.ko: 저는 그 선물을 손으로 직접 만들었어요.
cards.en: I made the gift by hand.
cards.gram: by hand = 손으로 직접. Handmade gift 질문에.

cards.en: More often than not, I eat at home.
cards.gram: more often than not = 대개, 자주. usually만 반복하지 않기.

cards.en: Every now and then, I watch a movie with my friends.
cards.gram: every now and then = 가끔. 비슷한 말: from time to time.

cards.en: I go to the zoo once in a blue moon.
cards.gram: once in a blue moon = 아주 가끔.

cards.en: I've been exercising on and off.
cards.gram: on and off = 했다 안 했다, 간헐적으로.

cards.ko: 그 책은 생각할 거리를 많이 줬어요.
cards.en: The book gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.gram: food for thought = 생각할 거리.

cards.en: I started growing plants.
cards.gram: 식물을 키우다 = grow plants. grow up은 사람이 자라다: The kids are growing up fast.

cards.ko: 우리 도시는 더 안전하고 깨끗해져야 해요.
cards.en: My city needs to be safer and cleaner.
cards.gram: need to be + 비교급 = 더 ~해져야 한다. Hometown 개선 질문에.

cards.en: It is very harmful to the environment.
cards.gram: harmful to ~ = ~에 해로운. the environment, the government, the internet에는 the!

cards.ko: 플라스틱 대신 재사용 가능한 제품을 쓸 수 있어요.
cards.en: We can use reusable products instead of plastic ones.
cards.gram: instead of + 명사/-ing = ~ 대신. reusable = 재사용 가능한.

cards.en: There's a lot of rubbish on the street.
cards.gram: rubbish는 셀 수 없는 명사: a lot of rubbish, There's.

cards.ko: 차 막히는 걸 피하려고 일찍 나왔어요.
cards.en: I left early to beat the traffic.
cards.gram: beat the traffic = 차 막히기 전에 움직이다.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute drive.
cards.gram: It's a 10-minute drive/walk. minute은 단수(숫자-minute 형용사).

cards.en: It all boils down to money.
cards.gram: boil down to ~ = 결국 핵심은 ~이다.

cards.en: I cherish my old photos.
cards.gram: cherish = 소중히 여기다.

cards.en: I experienced it first hand.
cards.gram: first hand = 직접(경험으로).

cards.en: Taking the train is time-saving.
cards.gram: time-saving = 시간을 아껴 주는 ↔ time-consuming = 시간이 많이 드는.

cards.en: I was over the moon.
cards.gram: over the moon = 너무 기쁜. it felt 대신 주어를 I로: I was ~.

cards.en: Let's grab a coffee.
cards.gram: grab a coffee = 커피 한잔 하다(가볍게).

cards.ko: 대체로 저는 혼자 공부하는 게 좋아요.
cards.en: By and large, I prefer studying alone.
cards.gram: by and large = 대체로.

cards.en: I had terrible jet lag.
cards.gram: jet lag = 시차 피로. have jet lag.

cards.en: I got a sense of achievement when I finished it.
cards.gram: get a sense of achievement = 성취감을 느끼다.

cards.en: The trip was really fun.
cards.gram: fun = 즐거운, funny = 웃긴. 재밌는 여행은 fun!

cards.en: I bought it for a song.
cards.gram: buy something for a song = 헐값에 사다.

cards.en: I splashed out on a new laptop.
cards.gram: splash out on + 명사 = ~에 큰돈을 쓰다.

cards.ko: 저는 직접 입어 보고 사는 게 좋아요.
cards.en: I prefer to try it on in person.
cards.gram: try it on = 입어 보다. in person = 직접(가서).

cards.en: I value my privacy.
cards.gram: value = 소중하게 여기다. privacy 발음 [프라이버시].

cards.en: It's within walking distance.
cards.gram: within walking distance = 걸어갈 수 있는 거리.

cards.en: He wanted to talk to me.
cards.gram: 과거 이야기는 끝까지 과거형: wanted.

cards.ko: 그는 하루에 두 시간씩 일본어로 말했어요.
cards.en: He spoke Japanese for two hours a day.
cards.gram: 동사가 빠지면 안 돼요. 과거라 spoke. -ing만 쓰면 동사가 아니에요.
cards.mine: He speaking Japanese 2 hours a day.

cards.en: My father and I travelled to Japan.
cards.gram: 다른 사람을 먼저, 나는 뒤에: My father and I. travel to + 장소.

cards.en: Most people think family is important.
cards.gram: most people. most of 뒤에는 the/my 같은 한정사가 필요: most of my friends.

cards.en: I was affected by my family a lot.
cards.gram: 수동태 be affected by ~ = ~에게 영향을 받다.

cards.en: It was really surprising.
cards.gram: 그게 주는 느낌은 -ing: surprising. 내 기분은 -ed: I was surprised.

cards.en: It's a 10-minute walk.
cards.gram: It's a 10-minute walk. = It takes 10 minutes on foot. 두 가지 다 쓸 줄 알기.

cards.en: Does this come in a larger size?
cards.gram: Does this come in + 사이즈/색? = ~로도 나와요? 예: Does this come in black?

cards.en: I need to get into a routine.
cards.gram: get into a routine = 일정한 습관을 들이다.

cards.ko: 그건 제가 제일 좋아하는 책 중 하나예요.
cards.en: It's one of my favourite books.
cards.gram: one of + 복수명사: one of my favourite books.

cards.en: I grow tomatoes at home.
cards.gram: 식물은 grow, 사람이 자라는 건 grow up. 식물에 grow up ❌

cards.ko: 그 책을 손에서 놓을 수가 없었어요.
cards.en: I couldn't stop reading it.
cards.gram: can't stop -ing / can't help -ing = ~하는 걸 멈출 수 없다.

cards.en: Ads always pop up on the screen.
cards.gram: pop up = 갑자기 튀어나오다. Advertisement 질문에.

cards.en: We live in the computer age.
cards.gram: the computer age / era = 컴퓨터 시대.

cards.en: For the time being, I live with my parents.
cards.gram: for the time being = 당분간, 현재로서는.

cards.en: Let's make the most of it.
cards.gram: make the most of ~ = ~을 최대한 활용하다(뽕을 뽑다).

cards.en: Don't nitpick.
cards.gram: nitpick = 사소한 걸로 트집 잡다.

cards.en: What do you fancy?
cards.gram: 주문·제안할 때: What do you fancy? / What are you after? / What can I get you?

cards.en: He answered half-heartedly.
cards.gram: half-heartedly = 건성으로, 마지못해.

cards.en: Did I get my point across?
cards.gram: get one's point across = 하고 싶은 말을 전달하다.

cards.en: It is important to drink lots of water.
cards.gram: It is + 형용사 + to 동사 = ~하는 건 ~하다.

cards.en: I go home right after work.
cards.gram: home은 부사로도 써서 go home(to 없음). 집에 있다는 at home.

cards.ko: 저는 그 영화를 끝까지 다 봤어요.
cards.en: I watched the movie all the way through.
cards.gram: all the way through = 처음부터 끝까지. half way through = 중간까지.

cards.en: I'm trying to cut down on alcohol.
cards.gram: cut down on ~ = ~을 줄이다.

cards.ko: 저는 다른 사람들을 만나는 걸 좋아해요.
cards.en: I like meeting other people.
cards.gram: other + 복수명사: other people. 한 명이면 another person.

cards.en: It felt surreal.
cards.gram: surreal = 꿈같은, 비현실적인. ethereal도 비슷해요.

cards.en: In my childhood, I played the guitar.
cards.gram: in my childhood = 어릴 때. 악기 앞에는 the: play the guitar.

cards.en: I lie on the sofa and relax.
cards.gram: lie = 눕다(lie-lay-lain), lay = 눕히다, 놓다(lay-laid-laid).

cards.en: I have a hankering for spicy food.
cards.gram: have a hankering for ~ = ~이 몹시 당기다.

cards.en: He started his business from scratch.
cards.gram: from scratch = 처음부터, 맨땅에서 = out of thin air.

cards.en: I'll go with A.
cards.gram: I'll go with ~ = ~로 정할게요. 고를 때 쓰는 말.

cards.en: My home is a safe haven for me.
cards.gram: safe haven = 안식처, 안전한 곳.

cards.en: I went sightseeing at the weekend.
cards.gram: go sightseeing = 관광하다. landmark, tourist attraction도 같이 쓰기.

cards.en: He's an expert in this field.
cards.gram: expert = 전문가(사람), expertise = 전문 지식.
